items.text: Key project decisions for ResearchIt between June 24-26, 2026: prioritize stability; avoid SearXNG in V1.0 (use Bing scraping from OCI with rate limiting of 1 request every 2 seconds); add Reddit as a source via Composio MCP; adopt Typst+Pandoc as the definitive PDF generator (discarding WeasyPrint and Puppeteer); avoid DuckDuckGo from OCI; and set PDF formatting to mobile-friendly with DejaVu Sans 15pt, margins 2.2cm, and line spacing 1.2em.

Decisiones clave del proyecto tomadas entre el 24 y 26 de junio de 2026: priorizar estabilidad; no usar SearXNG en V1.0 (usar Bing scraping directo desde OCI con rate limiting de 1 petición cada 2 segundos); incorporar Reddit como fuente adicional vía Composio MCP; adoptar Typst+Pandoc como generador PDF definitivo (descartando WeasyPrint y Puppeteer por su peso); no usar DuckDuckGo desde OCI; y configurar PDF mobile-friendly con fuente DejaVu Sans a 15pt, márgenes de 2.2cm e interlineado de 1.2em.

items.text: ResearchIt documentary is a DIY deep research engine that converts a topic into a structured report using web search via SearXNG, scraping with httpx/BS4, synthesis with deepseek-v4-flash, and PDF generation with Typst. It integrates with Hermes Agent via WhatsApp for async research. Outputs: Markdown and mobile-friendly PDF with DejaVu Sans 15pt.

ResearchIt documentary es un motor de deep research autogestionado (DIY) que convierte un tema en un informe estructurado mediante búsqueda web (SearXNG localhost:4000), scraping (httpx/BS4), síntesis con deepseek-v4-flash y generación de PDF con Typst. Se integra con Hermes Agent vía WhatsApp para research asíncrona. Salida: Markdown + PDF mobile-friendly con DejaVu Sans 15pt.

Typst is the best option for generating PDFs from markdown on ARM64/OL9, already implemented, but MD to Typst conversion is fragile; Pandoc (binary ~40MB for ARM64) can convert MD to Typst, avoiding manual conversion; WeasyPrint and Puppeteer/Chromium are too heavy for 12GB RAM; recommended approach: install Pandoc for conversion and keep Typst for PDF compilation.
